needed.evidence: There is no purpose-built sidewalk, only a wall and a narrow strip of road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The narrow pedestrian area is completely blocked by parked cars.
needed.suggestion: Implement parking restrictions or designated parking bays to keep the pedestrian path clear.

needed.evidence: The ground surface on the right is uneven and broken.
needed.suggestion: Repave the pedestrian area on the right to remove trip hazards.
